column1: # SIMULATED DATA for teaching (seed 20271231). The analysis plan of Workshop 8 (planned
column3: exploratory). Made by analysis_full.R (Workshop 8) from the Workshop 7 analysis ready files. No real person was recorded.
Is brand recall more likely when the Logo was fixated?
column5: Fisher exact test on the pooled 2 x 2 table; each ad; mixed logistic regression

column3: Do ads that produce more Joy get liked more?
column4: Joy, percent of time (FEA export); liking (survey)
column5: Linear mixed model, liking ~ Joy/10 + ad + (1 | participant); correlations for each ad

column3: Are GSR peaks per minute higher during each ad than during Baseline?
column5: Paired t tests, d_z with 95% CI, Wilcoxon checks

column3: Does gaze dwell differ by AOI, and does the AOI pattern differ between the ads?
column4: Gaze dwell, percent of the ad: Logo, Product, Headline (AOI export)
column5: Linear mixed model, dwell ~ ad x AOI + (1 | participant): Type III F (Satterthwaite) and likelihood ratio tests; check: repeated measures ANOVA, Greenhouse Geisser

column3: Which AOIs differ within each ad?
column4: Gaze dwell, percent of the ad
column5: 6 paired t tests, d_z with 95% CI, Wilcoxon checks

column3: Does each AOI hold more gaze in one ad than in the other?
column4: Gaze dwell, percent of the ad
column5: 3 paired t tests, d_z with 95% CI, Wilcoxon checks

column3: Do Joy, Engagement, and Brow Furrow differ between Ad_A and Ad_B?
column4: Percent of time at or above threshold 50 (FEA export)
column5: 3 paired t tests, d_z with 95% CI, Wilcoxon checks (values pile up at zero)

column3: Do the ads differ on liking, brand recall, and arousal?
column4: Liking and recall (survey); GSR Peaks Per Minute (GSR export)
column5: Paired t tests (liking, GSR), exact McNemar test (recall)

column3: Did order (AB or BA) or position (first or second) change liking or dwell?
column4: Liking; gaze dwell on Logo, Product, Headline
column5: Linear mixed model, y ~ ad x order + (1 | participant): order effect and position effect

column3: How do the measures of different modalities go together across participants?
column4: Logo dwell, Joy, GSR change, liking, recall, purchase intention, attitude
column5: Spearman rho with 95% CI (Fisher z, Bonett and Wright), 21 pairs, no p values

column3: What could n = 22 detect, and what n does the next study need?
column5: power.t.test (paired); power.prop.test and a Fisher exact test simulation for H1
